setting: You both live in Lyon, in the Croix-Rousse and Guillotière neighbourhoods, and have been friends since you were classmates at the same lycée. You know each other's families, exes and jobs, and you both know that money has been tight for Julien since his last contract ended. You last talked about a broken ticket machine at the Hôtel de Ville tram stop, which made you both laugh.
opener: Apologise and propose repaying the loan in monthly instalments.

Julien.who: 34, man, the friend who owes money
Julien.knows: You know Chloé is your oldest friend in Lyon, the one who always picks up. You know she lent you 1,200 euros in the spring and has not pushed you about it yet.
Julien.like: You are easygoing and self-deprecating, and you make jokes when things get awkward. You have strong opinions about coffee, bad sound mixes and public transport.
Julien.texts: You message Chloé now and then, mostly when something is going on or you need a favour.

Chloé.who: 33, woman, the friend who is owed money
Chloé.knows: You know Julien is your friend since lycée, and you have seen him through a few rough patches. You know he is a sound engineer whose income is unreliable, and you lent him 1,200 euros in the spring.
Chloé.like: You are direct and dry-witted, and you tend to hold things in until they build up. You have firm opinions about fairness, punctuality and people keeping their word.
Chloé.texts: You reply to Julien regularly but rarely start a conversation yourself.
Chloé.style: You type with proper capitals and full stops, and use emoji only occasionally.

private_lines.Julien: You live alone in a small flat in Croix-Rousse and work freelance as a sound engineer for theatres and small venues. Your days start late and run into the evening, and some nights you are at a venue until midnight. Work has been patchy since the summer, so you spend a lot of time chasing invoices and feeling guilty about money.
private_lines.Chloé: You live in Guillotière with your partner Théo and work as a pharmacist at a busy pharmacy, mostly on early and mid-day shifts. Your days are structured and tiring, and you like quiet evenings at home. Money is comfortable but not loose, and the loan matters to you more than you usually say.

situation: A friend who owes money, and the friend they owe.
